{{Quote|One of our top agents has been trapped by Lord Vader, and we must act immediately to save him! Our secret operative, code-named "the Mouse," had nearly completed his sabotage of an Imperial garrison when Darth Vader arrived in person to close the well-planned trap.|[[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]|<ref name="SWG:AaTAA" />}}
'''The Mouse''' was the codename for a [[Special Agent/Legends|special agent]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:AaTAA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Mouse was trapped by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] during a mission to sabotage an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. After an intense battle with Imperial troops, an Alliance strike team successfully rescued the Rebel agent.<ref name="SWG:AaTAA" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mouse was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AaTAA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
